customer_id.meaning: Primary id of the household (parent or guardian) profile.

name.meaning: Full name of the parent or legal guardian who holds the household profile, as on the photo ID presented at registration.

phone.meaning: Primary phone number on the household profile.

email.meaning: Primary email address on the household profile.

date_of_birth.meaning: Date of birth of the parent or guardian who holds the profile.

id_last4.meaning: Last four digits of the government photo ID the parent or guardian presented at registration.

home_address.meaning: Residence street address on file, the address used for attendance zone, walk-zone distance and residency verification.

home_zip.meaning: ZIP code of the residence address.

in_district_residence.meaning: Whether the residence address on file lies inside the district boundary (false for non-resident transfer households).

district_employee.meaning: Whether the parent or guardian is a current Calloway Creek ISD employee, as confirmed by Human Resources.

preferred_language.meaning: Language the household prefers for notices.

profile_opened_date.meaning: Date the household profile was opened in the district's student information system.

student_id.meaning: Primary id of the student record.

customer_id.meaning: Household the student belongs to (foreign key -> customers).

local_student_number.meaning: District-issued student ID number printed on the student ID card and report card.

zoned_campus.meaning: Attendance-zone campus for the student's current grade at the residence address on file.

categorical_status.meaning: Categorical eligibility designation recorded by the district's homeless liaison, foster care liaison or migrant program; none when no designation is on file.

iep_status.meaning: Whether the student has an active special education IEP or a Section 504 plan on file.

iep_transportation_service.meaning: Whether the student's active IEP lists special transportation as a related service; false when there is no active IEP.

emergent_bilingual.meaning: Whether the student is identified as an emergent bilingual (English learner) student.

military_connected.meaning: Whether a parent is an active-duty U.S. armed forces member or was injured or killed on active duty.

verification_id.meaning: Primary id of the identity verification record (one per household).

customer_id.meaning: Household whose caller was verified (foreign key -> customers).

verified.meaning: Whether identity verification passed; once true it never returns to false.

verified_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
verified_at.meaning: Moment of the most recent verification attempt.

handoff_id.meaning: Primary id of the human handoff record.

reason.meaning: Reason for the handoff; closed set of exactly these two values.

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

customer_id.meaning: Household that holds the enrollment (foreign key -> customers).

student_id.meaning: Student enrolled in care (foreign key -> students).

school_year.meaning: School year the enrollment covers (July 1 - June 30).

registration_date.meaning: Date the registration was received; the date the enrollment was opened.

start_date.meaning: First day of care, requested at registration and confirmed at activation or waitlist placement.

end_date.meaning: Last day of care once the enrollment is withdrawn, dismissed or ended; empty while open.

waitlist_date.meaning: Date the registration joined the waitlist; empty if never waitlisted.

waitlist_offer_date.meaning: Date the program office offered a seat to the waitlisted registration; empty if no offer has been made.

suspended_date.meaning: Date care was suspended for nonpayment; empty when not suspended.

subsidy_payer.meaning: Third-party funder of the enrollment; none when the household pays its own tuition.

plan_change_effective_date.meaning: First day of the billing month from which the most recent plan change applies; empty if the plan never changed.

care_ledger_id.meaning: Primary id of the Extended Day ledger entry; quoted as the reference of a charge or payment.

care_enrollment_id.meaning: Enrollment the entry belongs to (foreign key -> care_enrollments).

customer_id.meaning: Household the entry belongs to (foreign key -> customers).

event_type.meaning: Ledger event family; decides whether the amount is a charge (increases the balance due) or a payment or credit (decreases it).

amount.meaning: Amount of the entry as a positive magnitude; its direction on the balance due is fixed by event_type.

school_year.meaning: School year an annual registration fee covers; empty on other entries.

billing_month.meaning: Billing month a tuition charge, late payment fee, plan change fee or board remittance relates to; empty on other entries.

service_date.meaning: Day of care a day fee or late pickup fee relates to; empty on other entries.

day_type.meaning: Kind of booked day for a day fee; not_applicable on other entries.

rate_basis.meaning: Tuition rate basis applied to a tuition charge; not_applicable on other entries.

sibling_position.meaning: Child's sibling position for a tuition charge's billing month (1 full rate, 2 second child, 3 third or later); 1 on entries other than tuition charges.

proration.meaning: Whether a tuition charge is a full month or a half-month first month; not_applicable on other entries.

payment_method.meaning: How a family payment was made; not_applicable on other entries.

payment_reference.meaning: Payment confirmation number exactly as issued by the payment portal or printed on the receipt; empty on other entries.

credit_reason.meaning: Reason for a credit; not_applicable on other entries.

source_care_ledger_id.meaning: Reference of the original charge a credit offsets, or of the original payment a returned payment or returned payment fee relates to; empty on other entries.

subsidy_payer.meaning: Funder of a board remittance; not_applicable on other entries.

care_attendance_id.meaning: Primary id of the attendance log entry.

event_type.meaning: Attendance event family: a late pickup or a late-pickup warning letter.

service_date.meaning: Date of the late pickup, or date the warning letter was issued.

minutes_late.meaning: Whole minutes between the plan's close time and the sign-out time for a late pickup; 0 on a warning letter.

fee_status.meaning: Whether a late pickup carries a fee; not_applicable on a warning letter.

semester.meaning: Semester of the entry: fall is August 1 - December 31, spring is January 1 - June 30.

care_enrollment_id.meaning: Enrollment the request concerns (foreign key -> care_enrollments).

request_type.meaning: Kind of request the family made.

requested_date.meaning: Date the request asks for: the requested last day of care, the service date of a drop-in day, or the first day of the month a plan change should apply; empty for a courtesy waiver.

registration_date.meaning: Date the registration was submitted; the date the record was opened.

entry_date.meaning: First day of attendance under this record.

residency_verified_date.meaning: Date residency was verified for the school year; empty while unverified or when the type needs no residency proof.

withdrawal_date.meaning: Last day of attendance once withdrawn, or the last instructional day once the year is completed; empty while open.

leaver_reason.meaning: Reason recorded when the record closes; not_applicable while open or for a year completed by a non-graduate.

prek_eligibility_basis.meaning: State Pre-K eligibility basis on which a state-eligible Pre-K enrollment rests; not_applicable otherwise.

meal_account_id.meaning: Primary id of the student's cafeteria meal account.

student_id.meaning: Student the account belongs to (foreign key -> students).

variant_name.meaning: Official NSLP/SBP meal status the student currently holds.

status.meaning: Lifecycle status of the meal account.

campus.meaning: Campus whose cafeteria the student uses; decides the pricing level and the CEP override.

benefit_effective_date.meaning: Date the current meal status took effect.

inactive_date.meaning: Date the account became inactive; empty while active.

closed_date.meaning: Date the account was closed; empty while not closed.

meal_transaction_id.meaning: Primary id of the meal account transaction; quoted as the reference of a purchase line or deposit.

void_reason.meaning: Reason for a void; not_applicable on other transactions.

refund_reason.meaning: Reason for a refund; not_applicable on other transactions.

counterpart_meal_account_id.meaning: The other meal account in a sibling transfer; empty on other transactions.

meal_account_id.meaning: Meal account the notice concerns (foreign key -> meal_accounts).

submitted_date.meaning: Date the application was received by School Nutrition Services.

measured_distance_miles.meaning: Routing-system shortest public road distance from the residence address on file to the campus entrance.
